title: Soften co-located flashlight falloff
objective: Adjust the flashlight/orbit workflow so scene_off_flashlight_on no longer looks like a hard circular hole, while preserving the dark scene-off baseline and existing light intensity/direction controls.
instructions: Investigate the current spawned ASpotLight setup in examples/flashlight/run.py and examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py.
The user-visible issue: scene_off_flashlight_on is clean but visually unnatural; it looks like looking through a circular hole. The co-located light should have smooth falloff, not a hard circle.

Make the default validation profile softer. Prefer a broad penumbra/floodlight profile over the current narrow circular aperture; for example consider a much smaller inner cone and wider outer cone, plus lower intensity/adjusted attenuation if needed.

Expose any useful Unreal spotlight shape controls that are available from Python, such as source radius or soft source radius, with robust best-effort setters that do not break older binaries if a property/method is missing.
Apply the same light-shape behavior in live run.py, teleop, and render/orbit modes.
Keep existing intensity, direction, scene-light scaling, fixed exposure, spawn_flashlight=false diagnostic, and no-indirect-bounce behavior intact.
Update focused tests for argument validation, light component setter behavior, and/or workflow defaults. Run the available unit test command.
Do not commit. Return a ResultPacket with exact changes, tests run, and any recommended render command for visual validation.
constraints: No Git commits, pushes, force operations, or history rewrites.
Do not run a long Unreal render unless needed; code/tests first. If live visual validation is needed, return an Experimenter handoff recommendation.
expected_outputs: Implemented softer co-located flashlight falloff controls/defaults, or a clear blocked result if Unreal/SPEAR cannot support it.
definition_of_done: Unit tests pass via the available test runner.
Defaults used by run_orbit_workflow.sh produce a softer spotlight profile than the committed hard-circle settings.
